We propose V007-C3k2SimAM, a lightweight attention-enhanced YOLO11s variant for tiny shrimp disease lesion detection. The method preserves the original YOLO11 detection pipeline, including its C2PSA module and P3/P4/P5 detection heads, while augmenting selected C3k2 backbone blocks with SimAM. SimAM provides parameter-free 3D attention over feature maps, allowing the model to emphasize disease-relevant local patterns without substantially increasing model size. Mosaic augmentation is disabled to preserve natural shrimp image context and avoid further shrinking small lesion regions. At inference, a higher resolution of 1536 is used to retain fine-grained lesion details.

The paper evaluates **YOLO26m-cls + ASL-LDAM + SimAM-DCFR** as a practical model-specific improvement over the native Ultralytics YOLO cross-entropy (CE) baseline.
- **ASL-LDAM**: class-imbalance-aware loss combining asymmetric focusing and LDAM-style margin tuning.
- **SimAM-DCFR**: attention / recalibration variant used for the best method.
